title: eng-ml
text:
eng-ml

Sam: Midday async — quick round. Onboarding: pushed tinyQ/v2 to staging, ran eval suite 1. Found regression on conversational persona for Spanish prompts (accuracy drop ~6%). Blocker: failing tokenization for emojis in spanish tokenizer. Anyone seen this? @Anika @Chris
Anika: Thanks — saw similar for synthia-v2, looks like kv-cache offset when emojis are present. Repro: run `pytest tests/onboard/test_tokenize.py::test_spanish_emojis` segfaults in tokenizer step.
Chris: I'll take a look after standup, could be tokenizer params mismatch between model and token config. Assigning to me; will patch and push a hotfix to staging.
Maya: FYI I noticed eval evasion cases where prompt prefix length causes early stopping; maybe related. Posted a small sample in gist: https://gist.github.com/xyz
Sam: Also pinging for code review: PR #4826 needs a quick LGTM for the tokenizer update. Small change, tests included.
Chris: On it, will review in 30m. If I can't reproduce locally I'll ask for a repro snippet.
devops-bot: Deploy queued: staging tinyQ-v2-hotfix by chris in 12m — will run smoke tests.
Anika: For today: triage reproducer, prepare rollback plan if deploy regresses latency. Blocker for me is access to the spanish promptset branch — Sam can you grant?
Sam: Granted. I also opened an eval ticket (EVAL-1192) with examples and expected outputs.
Maya: I'll run the gated evals after the hotfix and report back here.
Sam: Great — if no major issues let's aim to promote to staging-sanity by EOD. :thumbsup:
